messages:
maya: Heads-up sync: I'm drafting a minimal escrow-handshake for multi-region residency. Goal: keep local write latencies tight while preserving legal consent and safe failover.

oliver: short question: do we allow the remote to become a read-only copy only, or can it take over writes during failover?

maya: default single-writer per-tenant. Remote can become writer only after an explicit lease swap that requires escrow backlog drained and consent checks.

arjun: how do we detect drained backlog? metric-wise?

maya: escrow_backlog_bytes and escrow_lag_seconds per-tenant. Operator threshold: backlog < 10MB and lag < 30s to allow automated swap; else require manual confirmation.

diana: consent needs to be immutable and auditable. Proposal: consent_ledger (append-only) with KMS-signed tokens and an audit-row that contains who/when/why. Replicator rejects payloads if consent not present or reversed.

oliver: SDK surfaces? apps need clear machine-readable errors. I suggest {code: RESIDENCY_BLOCKED, allow_fallback: false, hint: "consent_required"} and {code: RESIDENCY_FAILOVER_READ_ONLY, allow_fallback: true, fallback_region: "eu-west-1"}.

arjun: protocol sketch: 1) prepare-meta: reserve sequence id + record consent token 2) commit-local: append data + escrow-pointer 3) ACK-meta: mark meta-committed 4) async-replicator pulls pointer -> finalize on remote -> mark replicated=true.

diana: cache invalidation: include version-token in escrow pointer so each proxy invalidates prefix caches when replicated version advances. Makes stale reads detectable.

sre-bot: [info] automated test run: injected partition between region-A and region-B for 90s; no dual-writes observed for strict-residency tenants.

maya: ops-runbook notes: make swap idempotent, gate swaps behind escrow_backlog and escrow_lag checks, and require human confirmation when consent_ledger contains flags >1 change in last 24h.

oliver: please add a tiny RFC section on error codes and observability. Also add a dashboard for escrow_lag_seconds P50/P90/P99 by tenant.

arjun: I'll build a small sim harness to validate edge cases (clock skew, delayed replicator, rapid swap). ETA 10 days.

diana: I'll draft consent_ledger schema and retention rules. include legal sign-off checklist.

maya: thanks — I'll assemble the short RFC and ping #eng and #legal.
